notes:
v4.6.33 — Cloud-bot broker isolation + honest IBKR pre-flight

🔀 BOTS NO LONGER SHOW RUNNING IN BOTH BROKERS
• A cloud bot started under Alpaca was appearing as running under IBKR too, because the cloud lifecycle was keyed by side only (the server sees one 'LONG').
• Cloud-execution flags are now per-broker: cloud_bots_alpaca / cloud_bots_ibkr. The desktop only resumes cloud running state for bots flagged cloud in the CURRENT broker.
• Legacy global cloud_bots migrates automatically into Alpaca.

🚫 IBKR PRE-FLIGHT IS HONEST NOW
• In IBKR mode the bot start was demanding an Alpaca API key, which was misleading — Alpaca keys aren't what runs IBKR.
• IBKR mode now refuses to start bots with a clear message: order execution still goes through Alpaca, so bots can't yet trade IBKR; switch to Alpaca to run the bot. This prevents accidentally trading the Alpaca account from the IBKR view.

Note: building real IBKR order execution (so bots actually trade IBKR) + giving the cloud server per-broker bot processes is the next chunk — both are server-involving and untestable without a running IB Gateway. This release fixes the visible client-side isolation so the two views stop bleeding into each other.
